results: Shared LOCAL complex-analysis deflation removes two actual roots, with a derivative condition only when the roots coincide. Exact factorization holds even at both removed roots. Analyticity is required only near the closed disc, not on the entire plane; the local maximum-modulus bound does not assume an unavailable entire extension.

A uniform error delta^2*r^2 against the free square -(lambda-c^2)^2/(4*c^2) places each actual root within2*c*r*delta of c^2. For0<=delta<=1/4 the exact normalized filled quotient -4*c^2*Q is within24*delta of ONE throughout the full closed disc, including a repeated root. No division by the gap length is used.

For the ACTUAL H-minus-one Hill filled primitive square K, the exact ACTUAL two-root algebraic multiplicity proves the missing derivative condition at a collapsed gap. The whole-disc native trace, radicand-zero and free-normalized continued-primitive identities are preserved in the same family.

ONE positive radius precedes EVERY requested accuracy; ONE cutoff and ONE OPEN complex H-minus-one potential neighborhood precede ALL later original positive indices and EVERY potential in that neighborhood. The ACTUAL normalized filled square is analytic in the energy and uniformly near ONE on each ENTIRE original energy disc.

The principal root S of that actual normalized quotient is ANALYTIC and NONZERO on the whole energy disc, including both endpoints and collapsed gaps. Its EXACT identity is K(lambda,a)=-(lambda-l)*(lambda-u)*S(lambda)^2/(4*(pi*n)^2), with the original positive physical index. The SAME common neighborhood/cutoff gives norm(S-1)<=epsilon on EVERY later full disc.

This is a necessary analytic normalization step toward source Theorem3.2 and the ACTUAL KdV Birkhoff map. It does NOT yet define or identify the Hill contour actions, prove their gap-square ratio or joint potential analyticity, identify global real spectral action coordinates, construct the KdV Birkhoff map, or construct the actual smooth-approximation KdV flow. ALL FIVE MAIN source theorems remain UNPROVED; goal ACTIVE.
